summary: Frontend-only visual refinement pass verified on the 7HUES Expeditions homepage. Homepage loads past the '7HUES' loading screen and all sections render. Navbar is correctly trimmed to only the 3 required links (nav-experiences, nav-info-faq, nav-journal) with nav-book-cta preserved; the removed nav-expeditions and nav-destinations are no longer present. The scroll-motorcycle stays vertically centered (bounding box center Y === viewport middle at all 3 scroll offsets tested) and its X translates noticeably (range ~442px). Decorator .h-px divider lines are gone from section-what-we-do, section-how-we-deliver, section-why, and section-journal headers. Warmer paper background rgb(236,228,214) (#ECE4D6) is applied on body. Cinematic footer renders with the background image loaded, 'THE WORLD IS CALLING.' / 'ANSWER IT.' text, footer-book-cta, and social-instagram/youtube/facebook links. No broken images. Two nits: (1) the scroll-motorcycle rendered bounding-box width is ~74-78px at 1440px viewport (spec asked ~28-56px); with lg:w-10 (40px) plus rotation the bounding box could reach ~57px, but the observed 78px suggests the image itself renders larger than spec — recommend reducing to w-5/w-6/w-7/w-8 or w-6 sm:w-7 md:w-8 lg:w-9. (2) In section-people only 1 of 5 elements has the .feather class; if all imagery is meant to be feathered, add the class to the remaining 4.

ui_bugs.issue: Rendered bounding-box width ~74-78px at 1440 viewport; spec requested ~28-56px. Even accounting for rotation of a 40px (lg:w-10) image the max bbox is ~57px, so the image is actually larger than the tailwind class implies (or class not applied). Reduce sizing (e.g., w-5 sm:w-6 md:w-7 lg:w-8).

issues: Only 1 of 5 tags carries the .feather class. If the intent was to feather all people imagery, add .feather to the remaining 4.

Outer <header> computed backgroundColor is rgba(0,0,0,0) with backdropFilter=none at scroll 0; visually the header still looks translucent (screenshot confirms grey wash), so the effect is likely on an inner element. Not a blocker, but worth verifying the intended translucent bg-charcoal/40 backdrop-blur-lg is actually mounted on the correct element.

action_items: Shrink scroll-motorcycle so its rendered bounding box lands in ~28-56px range (currently ~78px at lg).
Apply .feather class to the remaining images inside section-people (only 1/5 has it).
Optionally confirm translucent header bg (bg-charcoal/40 backdrop-blur-lg) is applied to the correct DOM node (outer <header> reports transparent bg).
critical_code_review_comments: RoadJourney bike size mismatch between tailwind classes (w-7..lg:w-10 => 28-40px) and actual rendered bbox (74-78px). Check if a transform: scale or a larger intrinsic image is inflating it.
Header translucency: verify style is applied on the correct element so backdrop-blur reaches getComputedStyle.
